scripts.build: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'pnpm gen --inputs-only && tsc -b tsconfig.layers.json --builders 1 && node scripts/build-shardfiles.mjs && node scripts/build-app.mjs && node scripts/check-devserver.mjs dist'
scripts.build:proof: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'node scripts/gen.mjs --proof && node scripts/build-shardfiles.mjs --reuse && node scripts/build-app.mjs && node scripts/check-devserver.mjs dist'
scripts.build:native: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'node scripts/build-shardfiles.mjs --reuse && node scripts/build-app.mjs --mode native'
scripts.build:drafts: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'vite build --config drafts/vite.config.ts'
scripts.build:site: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash -c 'vite build --config site/vite.config.ts'
scripts.lint: pnpm gen:source --check && pnpm gen --inputs-only && node scripts/lint-all.mjs
scripts.test: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py check -- node scripts/vitest-tmp.ts run
scripts.assets:nine-sign-atlas: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash scripts/browser-lane.sh node --experimental-transform-types --import ./scripts/bake-loader.mjs src/shards/nine-dragon-stack/generators/bake-sign-atlas.mjs --native-inputs
scripts.native:sync: pnpm build:native && cap sync && node scripts/native-paths.mjs
scripts.assets:nine-glyphs: python3 scripts/heavy-lane.py build -- bash scripts/browser-lane.sh node --experimental-transform-types --import ./scripts/bake-loader.mjs src/shards/nine-dragon-stack/generators/bake-glyphs.mjs --native-inputs
